The '''Ziost system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Worlds]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]].

After the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the system<ref name="AoR Rulebook" /> and other references to it<ref name="EoE Rulebook">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> were purged from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] navigation charts and other information stores.<ref name="AoR Rulebook">[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Ziost system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]]. Although the system was listed as being located in grid square R-5 in the Appendix section of ''The Essential Atlas'', the book's map of the [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Worlds]] placed it within square R-4,<ref name="TEA" /> which was repeated in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the book.<ref name="EAOC" /> This article assumes the book's Appendix section is erroneous and that R-4 is the correct square.
